files.README.md:
# ledgerly

Accounting backend: invoices and credit notes (FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + Alembic).

- `GET /invoices/{id}` returns an invoice with its lines and total (see docs/api.md).
- Migrations: `alembic upgrade head`.
- Tests: `pytest`.
- Nightly: `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py` emails finance any invoice whose stored total differs from its printed total (see `deploy/crontab`).

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from ledgerly.db import Base
from ledgerly.invoices.models import Invoice


class CreditNoteLine(Base):
    __tablename__ = "credit_note_lines"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    credit_note_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("credit_notes.id"))
    description: Mapped[str]
    quantity: Mapped[float]
    unit_price: Mapped[float]

    def amount(self) -> float:
        return self.quantity * self.unit_price


class CreditNote(Base):
    __tablename__ = "credit_notes"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    number: Mapped[str]
    invoice_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("invoices.id"))
    issued_on: Mapped[date]
    lines: Mapped[list[CreditNoteLine]] = relationship()
    invoice: Mapped[Invoice] = relationship()

    @property
    def is_full_refund(self) -> bool:
        return self.total() == self.invoice.total()

    def total(self) -> float:
        return round(sum(l.amount() for l in self.lines), 2)

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import date
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from sqlalchemy import ForeignKey
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column, relationship

from ledgerly.db import Base

VAT_RATE = Decimal("0.21")


class InvoiceLine(Base):
    __tablename__ = "invoice_lines"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    invoice_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("invoices.id"))
    quantity: Mapped[float]
    unit_price: Mapped[float]

    def amount(self) -> float:
        return self.quantity * self.unit_price


class Invoice(Base):
    __tablename__ = "invoices"
    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(primary_key=True)
    number: Mapped[str]
    status: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(default="draft")
    issued_on: Mapped[date | None]
    stored_total: Mapped[Decimal | None]
    lines: Mapped[list[InvoiceLine]] = relationship()

    def finalize(self) -> None:
        self.status = "open"
        self.stored_total = Decimal(str(self.total()))

    def vat(self) -> Decimal:
        return (Decimal(str(self.total())) * VAT_RATE).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)

    def total(self) -> float:
        return round(sum(l.amount() for l in self.lines), 2)

    def mark_paid(self) -> None:
        self.status = "paid"

files.ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py:
"""Nightly (cron): email finance any invoice whose stored total differs from its printed total."""
from decimal import ROUND_HALF_UP, Decimal

from ledgerly.db import get_session
from ledgerly.invoices.models import Invoice
from ledgerly.notify import email_finance


def printed_total(inv: Invoice) -> Decimal:
    """What the invoice PDF shows: each line rounded to cents, then summed."""
    cents = Decimal("0.01")
    return sum((Decimal(str(l.quantity * l.unit_price)).quantize(cents, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP) for l in inv.lines),
               Decimal("0.00"))


def reconcile_invoices() -> None:
    with get_session() as s:
        invoices = s.query(Invoice).filter(Invoice.stored_total.is_not(None)).all()
        mismatches = [(i.number, i.stored_total, printed_total(i)) for i in invoices if i.stored_total != printed_total(i)]
    if mismatches:
        body = "\n".join(f"  {number}  stored={stored:<7} computed={computed}" for number, stored, computed in mismatches)
        email_finance(f"reconcile_invoices: {len(mismatches)} mismatches (stored vs computed)", body)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    reconcile_invoices()

import smtplib
from email.message import EmailMessage

FINANCE = "finance@pantry.dev"


def email_finance(subject: str, body: str) -> None:
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"], msg["From"], msg["To"] = subject, "ledgerly@pantry.dev", FINANCE
    msg.set_content(body)
    with smtplib.SMTP("localhost") as smtp:
        smtp.send_message(msg)
